description: Lua effect clamping, marker ids, p-local alias, hp kill, on_input, on_finish

steps.script:
function on_start()
      lb.spawn_marker(10, 10, "a", "coin")
      lb.spawn_marker(20, 20, "b", "coin")
      lb.spawn_marker(30, 30, "c", "coin")
      lb.log("started")
    end
    function on_input(id, mx, my, action)
      if action == "interact" then lb.add_score(id, 4) end
    end
    local ticks = 0
    function on_tick(dt)
      ticks = ticks + 1
      if ticks % 7 == 0 then
        lb.set_position("p-local", 99999, -5)
        lb.add_score("p-1", 1)
        lb.set_hp("p-1", 200)
      end
      if ticks % 11 == 0 then
        lb.set_hp("p-1", 0)
      end
      if ticks == 40 then
        lb.remove_marker(2)
        lb.spawn_marker(5, 5, "d", "coin")
      end
    end
    function on_finish(winner)
      lb.log("winner " .. tostring(winner))
    end
